abstract: Maintains long-range strategic cargo freighter allocations and gross air payload allotments
system_message:
You are the Strategic air freight scheduler (CRG), responsible for maintaining long-range strategic cargo freighter allocations and gross air payload allotments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains long-range strategic cargo freighter allocations and gross air payload allotments（LIFT）
information_points.content:
CRG-LIFT-HEZ：For the James Bay Inland Routing, dispatch manifests for main trunk strategic airlift legs record a strategic freighter payload capacity of 50 t maximum allowable net cargo mass per assigned heavy airlifter sortie.
CRG-LIFT-0U1：For the Labrador Coastal Air Route, dispatch manifests for main trunk strategic airlift legs record a strategic freighter payload capacity of 40 t maximum allowable net cargo mass per assigned heavy airlifter sortie.
CRG-LIFT-22C：For the Hudson Bay Perimeter Corridor, dispatch manifests for main trunk strategic airlift legs record a strategic freighter payload capacity of 35 t maximum allowable net cargo mass per assigned heavy airlifter sortie.

information_points.title: Standard air cargo pallet stocking（PALLET）
information_points.content:
CRG-PALLET-ERN：At the air freight marshalling hangar, the Labrador Coastal Air Route has 45 available LD3 cargo containers ready for immediate aircraft loading.
CRG-PALLET-V27：At the air freight marshalling hangar, the James Bay Inland Routing has 35 available LD3 cargo containers ready for immediate aircraft loading.
CRG-PALLET-OBP：At the air freight marshalling hangar, the Hudson Bay Perimeter Corridor has 25 available LD3 cargo containers ready for immediate aircraft loading.
